metadata.name: hookwars_social
metadata.description: Hookwars (units): achievement badges and guild halls (docs/spec/10-expansion.md sections 3, 6, 7).

instructions.name: apply_params
docs: Anyone applies a ready params change.

instructions.name: apply_skills
docs: Applies a ready skill change (anyone).

instructions.name: approve_action
docs: An officer approves a pending action.

instructions.name: claim_badge
docs: Anyone claims a badge for a recipient that meets its criterion (the recipient is the
claimant's wallet, or a token's war chest for `FirstSiege`). The badge is minted into the
recipient's holding, which is then frozen: it cannot move.

instructions.name: create_badge
docs: The admin creates a badge type and its mint; claims open after `admin_timelock_secs`, so a
new badge is public before anyone can earn it.

instructions.name: create_guild
docs: Creates a guild; the founder is its only officer with threshold 1.

instructions.name: deposit_sol
docs: Anyone deposits SOL into a guild treasury. (Units tokens are deposited by an ordinary
transfer to the treasury's holding.)

instructions.name: execute_action
docs: Anyone executes an approved action after its delay. `SpendToken` passes the mint's slot
slices (if any) as remaining accounts, as a token transfer of that mint takes them.

instructions.name: init
docs: Creates the config; the program's upgrade authority signs.

instructions.name: init_skills
docs: Creates the skill table (admin, once).

instructions.name: open_profile
docs: Opens `wallet`'s profile (anyone pays the rent) (11 3.3).

instructions.name: propose_action
docs: An officer proposes a guild action; it can execute after `guild_timelock_secs` with the
threshold of approvals. The proposer's approval is counted.

instructions.name: propose_params
docs: The admin proposes new params; they apply after `admin_timelock_secs`.

instructions.name: propose_skills
docs: Proposes a new skill table and caller list (admin; applies after the admin timelock).

instructions.name: record_wallet
docs: Adds `value` to a wallet counter; signed by a registered caller program's PDA (R43).

accounts.name: caller
docs: The `["social-caller"]` PDA of a registered protocol program.

errors.name: NotUpgradeAuthority
errors.msg: the signer is not this program's upgrade authority

errors.name: NotAdmin
errors.msg: only the social admin may do this

errors.name: BadParams
errors.msg: a parameter is out of bounds

errors.name: NotReady
errors.msg: no params change is pending, or it is not ready yet

errors.name: WrongAccount
errors.msg: an account is not the one expected

errors.name: BadName
errors.msg: a name is empty or too long

errors.name: ClaimsNotOpen
errors.msg: claims for this badge are not open yet

errors.name: CriterionNotMet
errors.msg: the badge's criterion is not met

errors.name: NotOfficer
errors.msg: the signer is not an officer of this guild

errors.name: BadOfficers
errors.msg: officers or threshold out of bounds

errors.name: AlreadyExecuted
errors.msg: the action already executed

errors.name: NotEnoughApprovals
errors.msg: the action needs more approvals

errors.name: TooEarly
errors.msg: the action's delay has not passed

errors.name: StaleAction
errors.msg: the officers changed since this action was proposed

errors.name: ZeroAmount
errors.msg: amount must be above zero

errors.name: Overflow
errors.msg: arithmetic overflow

errors.name: BadSkill
errors.msg: a skill is malformed (counter out of range or thresholds not ascending)

errors.name: TooMany
errors.msg: too many skills or callers

errors.name: NotCaller
errors.msg: the signer is not a registered caller's PDA

errors.name: SkillsNotReady
errors.msg: no pending skill change, or not ready yet

errors.name: BadCounter
errors.msg: unknown counter

errors.name: DuplicateSkill
errors.msg: two skills share an id

errors.name: AlreadyClaimed
errors.msg: this item already earned this badge

types.name: BadgeAward
docs: `BadgeAward` at `["award", badge_id, recipient]`: one badge of a type per recipient.

types.name: BadgeType
docs: `BadgeType` at `["badge", id]`.

fields.name: claims_open_at
docs: Claims open at this time (`admin_timelock_secs` after creation).

types.name: Criterion
docs: What earns a badge: on-chain facts only, each read in O(1) (10 section 3.2). Criteria that would
need history the chain does not keep are not badges.

types.name: Guild
docs: `Guild` at `["guild", id]`.

fields.name: officers_version
docs: Changes whenever the officers change; pending actions of an older version cannot execute.

fields.name: actions
docs: Actions proposed (the next nonce).

types.name: GuildAction
docs: `GuildAction` at `["guild-action", guild_id, nonce]`.

fields.name: approvals
docs: Bit i: officer i approved.

types.name: GuildActionKind
docs: What a guild action does.

types.name: Profile
docs: `Profile` at `["profile", wallet]`.

types.name: SkillChange
docs: A pending skill table change.

types.name: SkillDef
docs: One skill: a counter and the thresholds of its levels (ascending; 0 ends the list).

types.name: SkillTable
docs: `SkillTable` at `["skills"]`.

fields.name: callers
docs: Programs whose `["social-caller"]` PDA may call `record_wallet`.

fields.name: badges
docs: Badge types created (the next id).

fields.name: guilds
docs: Guilds created (the next id).

types.name: SocialParams
docs: Parameters (10 section 13; all to set).

fields.name: guild_max_officers
docs: `GUILD_MAX_OFFICERS`.

fields.name: guild_timelock_secs
docs: `GUILD_TIMELOCK_SECS`: delay between a guild action's proposal and its execution.

fields.name: admin_timelock_secs
docs: `ADMIN_TIMELOCK_SECS` (00): delay on params changes and before a new badge can be claimed.
